era: HandWiki Start page as captured in Dec 2019 (Wayback, rendered with its CSS; the only 2019 capture of the site, which opened in 2019): teal gradient top bar with 'HandWiki Encyclopedia of science and computing' and a menu icon, left sidebar with the HandWiki globe logo, a search field and teal section bars (Navigation, Help, Tools), the page title with an Actions button, and teal 'Welcome to HandWiki' / 'Search' panels. Only one 2019 capture exists (Arquivo has none), so the three-source rule could not be met.

sources.shows: home-w20191203 page as served on 2019-12-03 (Wayback capture rendered with its archived 2019 CSS)
